issues.description: download_and_untar.sh warns about missing unzip but continues execution
issues.detail: The unzip check prints an error and falls through to set -euo pipefail code that calls unzip. It should exit 1 when unzip is missing. Similarly the bad-arg usage block prints help and then proceeds to run with $1 unset. These are broken guards - state the failure and exit.

issues.description: data.sh reuses utt.list as both input filter and output, clobbering filter mid-pipeline
issues.detail: wav.flist generates utt.list, then filter_scp.pl -f 1 utt.list trans is consumed, then `awk '{print $1}' transcripts.txt > utt.list` overwrites it. Fine here because filter already ran, but the reuse is confusing and fragile. Pick distinct names: utt.list.wav and utt.list.text. The next maintainer will misread this.

issues.description: Inline sed chain for Chinese punctuation normalization is unreadable and unmaintainable
issues.detail: Seven chained `sed 's/X//g'` calls inline in the pipeline. This is the BAD-TASTE special-case explosion: each punctuation mark is its own command. Use one `tr -d` or a single sed with character class, or factor into a normalize_text() function with the character set documented. Adding the next punctuation mark means appending another `| sed`. No.

issues.description: README config path is wrong and will confuse anyone trying to reproduce
issues.detail: README links `./conf/train/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml` but the file lives at `./conf/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml` (no train/ subdir). Broken link in the only doc the user reads. Fix the path.

issues.description: Unquoted command substitutions in download_and_untar.sh break on paths with spaces
issues.detail: `extract_dir=$(realpath $1)` and `zip_dir=$(realpath ${2:-$extract_dir})` are unquoted. A downloads path with a space silently splits. Quote them: `"$1"` and `"${2:-$extract_dir}"`. set -u doesn't save you here.

issues.description: Trailing newline missing on symlink files and comment typos in LM config
issues.detail: asr.sh, db.sh, path.sh, pyscripts symlinks all show `\ No newline at end of file` - cosmetic but trivially fixable. Also `train_lm_transformer.yaml` contains `# 15epoch is enougth` - typo in a config that ships. These are nits, but they're the kind of thing a one-pass cleanup eliminates.

review.summary: NEEDS-WORK. The recipe follows the existing egs2 template shape and the results table is plausible, so the overall scope is fine - this is one recipe, one dataset, as advertised. But the data prep shell scripts have real bugs: download_and_untar.sh warns and continues instead of failing on missing unzip or missing args, command substitutions are unquoted, and data.sh has an unreadable chain of seven sed punctuation strippers that screams BAD-TASTE. The README links to a config path that doesn't exist. Fix the broken guards, fix the doc link, collapse the punctuation sed-chain into one normalization step, and resubmit.
